pr_title: cli: additional enhancements after switching to jackc/pgx
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/72065

Release note (cli change): Using COPY in the CLI is now
supported while inside an explicit transaction.

Release note (bug fix): The DateStyle session setting is no longer
ignored when using the CLI when set in the `options` URL parameter.

Release note (cli change): Ctrl+C (the interrupt signal) can now be used
in the CLI to attempt to cancel the currently executing SQL query.

issue_context.title: cli: `cockroach sql` may override `DateStyle` when set with `-c`
issue_context.body:
When running this test:

```
spawn $argv sql --url "postgresql://test@localhost:26257?options=-cdatestyle%3Dymd"
eexpect root@
send "SHOW datestyle;\r"
eexpect "ISO, YMD"
eexpect root@
interrupt
eexpect eof
```

with `cockroach sql`, sometimes the `DateStyle` is `YMD`, sometimes the `DateStyle` is ISO,MDY.

This is because lib/pq sends ISO,MDY along as well:

https://github.com/lib/pq/blob/26399a76874b6cf27f551d02b9576e77b211ead1/connector.go#L89-L96

And as it is assigned to a map in the snippet below, the last one wins.

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/12afa456ab273fdb640d35ea3b5c676a4474e914/pkg/sql/pgwire/server.go#L850-L868

i imagine this to be a similar problem with other fields

Jira issue: CRDB-10931
comments: i don't think this is fixable without moving off lib/pq, or making lib/pq needs to understand datestyles
